Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark beside her navel. Background: a bright Victorian glass greenhouse with a pale tiled floor, tall palms, a waist-high iron rail and a standard-height glass door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
